messages:
Maya (CSM): FYI - Crestline flagged. Usage down ~45% M/M, new PM left last week, procurement is talking to CompetitorX. Raising a renewal-risk wake-up. dashboard: https://app.redwood/in/crestline/usage :wave:
Ethan (AM): ack. Do we have the renewal window? and did they sign annual or monthly?
Maya (CSM): renewal ~ in 68 days, annual. They committed to Dedicated but on lighter tier.
Liam (Solutions Eng): quick q - any infra or model changes in last 30 days? Could be perf/quality regression triggering the drop.
Maya (CSM): we rolled a quantized Llama-v2-small swap 3 weeks ago to cut cost. Customer noted more hallucinations + latency spikes after that.
Noah (Success Ops): I can pull top user cohorts + p95 latency, error rate, and token cost delta. Will also run a churn cohort for last 60 days. Pulling API keys list now.
Maya (CSM): customer comment from PM: "latency spikes during long chats, and procurement saw a 22% unit-cost increase compared to old plan" — they trialed CompetitorX for 48hrs and liked the UX.
Liam (Solutions Eng): proposal: 1) quick rollback of canary to previous model variant for 20% traffic, 2) run live perf comparison for key flows, 3) offer 90-day price protection on committed seats while we prove parity. I can prepare rollback command and perf script.
Liam (Solutions Eng): rollback snippet (canary):
```
redwood deploy rollback --project crestline --env prod --model-id llama-v2-small:v2-prev --traffic 20%
```
Noah (Success Ops): creating ticket CS-3128 to track triage + analytics. ETA for metrics: 3 hours. Will post link here when ready.
Ethan (AM): I'll own customer outreach. Suggested call with PM + engineering show-and-tell on Friday 10am PT. @Noah pls have cost delta numbers by then.
Maya (CSM): sounds good. If we can show p95 < 300ms on main flows and cost delta < 10%, procurement likely pauses the competitor eval. :crossed_fingers:
deploy-bot: rollback deploy-457 to llama-v2-small:v2-prev started on canary (20%) — job_id 457-rollback.
Noah (Success Ops): analytics link: https://analytics.redwood/CS-3128/crestline (will update with charts)
Ethan (AM): perfect. I'll send calendar invite and note agenda: perf demo, cost comparison, action items.
Maya (CSM): thanks team — keep updates short here. If we get customer on screen share, capture their eval criteria and any screenshots of the CompetitorX flows.
Liam (Solutions Eng): will prepare perf script and quick side-by-side screenshots of the UX differences to help the PM.
Noah (Success Ops): posted initial cohort table, looks like churn concentrated in 3 power-users. drilling into session traces now.
